title: One Journal · A Week
description: A reference-dependent four-image series: the same cream-paper journal photographed on four different days, preserving the handwriting style, page proportions, and the journal keeper's personal kit of pens and tapes.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the open journal with handwriting style and physical kit (pens, tape, stickers). Images 02-04 depend on 01 to preserve the exact same paper tone, handwriting cadence, and journal format while showing different days of pasted memories — seasons, weather, and collected ephemera evolve, but the human hand is identical.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
